directions.title: By Air
directions.description: Subic Bay International Airport is located nearby, with connecting flights from Manila and other major cities.

directions.title: By Land
directions.description: Accessible via SCTEX and NLEX. Approximately 2-3 hours from Manila.

directions.title: By Sea
directions.description: Subic Bay Freeport Zone has a major seaport with regular shipping services to international destinations.

directions.title: Public Transport
directions.description: Buses and jeepneys operate regularly from Olongapo City and nearby areas to the Freeport Zone.
